method: Independent static reading of preserved x86-64 module bytes, relocations, disassembly, metadata and source diff; no build, execution or VM access.

default-off.budget_scope: READY pinned spin path; an existing WAIT cancellation intentionally takes its separate preemptible path without consuming a new budget.
default-off.cold_retention_order: READY -> CLAIMED store precedes private epoch clear and full-u32 HELD CAS preserving WITHDRAW; address order is non-linear control flow, not lexical address sorting.
default-off.role_order: source-frame put CALL returns before C INIT->READY CAS, then W custody.ready store.
default-off.diagnostics_note: Absent mutex pin symbols/stat parameter and no origin accumulator.

pin-counts.budget_scope: READY pinned spin path; an existing WAIT cancellation intentionally takes its separate preemptible path without consuming a new budget.
pin-counts.cold_retention_order: READY -> CLAIMED store precedes private epoch clear and full-u32 HELD CAS preserving WITHDRAW; address order is non-linear control flow, not lexical address sorting.
pin-counts.role_order: source-frame put CALL returns before C INIT->READY CAS, then W custody.ready store.
pin-counts.diagnostics_note: Local origin accumulator zero stores use the reserved shadow stack: the first follows the link before first poll, the other two follow that load before its state tests. Its finish CALL occurs only after observed result-zero or irrevocable WAIT. No diagnostic helper executes between READY and first poll.

limits: This checks emitted ordering and preserved guards in these exact ELFs, not live concurrency, scheduler behavior, arbitrary compiler versions or full-kernel substitution.
Mode 2 has real diagnostic work and is not a performance-comparable default-off build.
No performance gain or regression acceptance is inferred from code size or instruction removal.
The source release operations compile to ordered x86 MOV stores; this is not a cross-architecture weak-memory proof.
